major: **This update is a full UI refresh!** Look around and see a ton of redesigned controls that now integrate more seamlessly with the themes.
**Increased animations!** Most animations have been consolidated and timed up to create a more cohesive experience.
**Removed the preset Stop All and Reload tiles!** They were originally intended to only be development tiles, when the system was just getting started.
**Added ALPHA language support!** This feature is however a very early alpha, but so far some translations have been added. If you'd like to contribute, contact me (@ia.74) over Discord.
**Soundboard tiles just got a major overhaul!** You can now make any tile stop all the playing sounds, and the UI for audio files has been majorly improved!
**Smoother animations!** This may not affect you, but the loading screen and almost every transition between pages has been overhauled, and now works nicely!
**Plugin loading has been improved!** Now, plugins should be quite a bit faster to load, thus decreasing startup time!
Also, the Folder action icons on the left sidebar have been fixed, their colors are now true to how they are supposed to be.
The Marketplace now can tell you if you have a newer or older version, and has colors as well for themes!
A lot of essential UI was hardcoded, but can now be themed! You will notice this upon applying a theme.
**Catppuccin Mocha** has gotten a large overhaul as well! It now fits a lot closer to the original vision for the theme, and is much better.
Fixed a lot of bugs, but notably:
Fixed bug where user was allowed to go out of bounds during audio file selection
Fixed bug where failing to connect to an audio device would cause the app to be fully unable to play sounds.
Fixed notification log filling and exceeding quota.
Some more fix-ups to the editor and it's performance
Fixed that theme changer bug that would delay Active theme displaying.
other: (rc3-01) Fixed bug where plugins wouldn't extract
Most settings are now consolidated to the local style configuration! This means settings updates are nolonger synchronous and can be applied instantaneously by listening for the config_changed event.
Changed the text on Connect from compiling bundles to Freedeck is starting... for user experience
